details:
The vrchat hub was my favorite world to go to for years and it's sad to see it all empty nowadays. There's not even a portal for it in vrchat home or tutorial which makes it even more empty. So I'm suggesting that you should update it. and here are some things that could be done with the hub.
1. Make the mirror a toggle
The mirror would always be on and nothing could be done about it so I believe having a toggle for it would also improve fps for those who play on potato pcs.
2. Bring back the old holiday hubs
The holiday hub I loved the most was the winter hub and I still miss it to this very day. There was also other holiday hubs such as valentines which was just winter hub but valetines themed and the St Patrick day hub.
I always like the holiday hubs and it would be nice for them to be seperate worlds so they be accessed at any time if they won't appear in the hub anymore.
3. Expand the hub. The current hub is kinda small and so is the player capacity so I think it would be a good idea to expand it a bit. Like make a new part on the side of the map like how you did with the holiday hubs such as winter and St. Patricks day. And increase the player capacity to 10.
4. Add more grabbable objects
Grabbable objects were fun to mess around with so I think you should also make more grabbable objects.
5. Maybe make 3 versions of the hub
Just 3 versions for different platforms such as pc quest or cross platform.
Those are some of the things that could be done with the hub it if it will ever get updates again.
title: Update the hub.
